note: Renal anomalies are documented as variable rather than fully penetrant in KDM2B CxxC-domain neurodevelopmental disorder (OMIM #621474), making the hypothesis coherent and plausible.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 19 individuals with KDM2B CxxC variants, congenital heart defects were found in up to 78% alongside common but variable urogenital, musculoskeletal, and ophthalmological anomalies, prompting recommendations for baseline renal ultrasound.

source.title: KDM2B variants in the CxxC domain impair its DNA-binding ability and cause a distinct neurodevelopmental syndrome
source.quote: Congenital heart defects were observed in up to 78% of individuals, with additional common findings including musculoskeletal, ophthalmological, and urogenital anomalies, as well as behavioral challenges and feeding difficulties.

evidence.text: Individuals with KDM2B CxxC variants exhibit neurodevelopmental delays, heart defects, and eye anomalies, with renal anomalies noted to be variably present rather than an obligate feature.

source.title: Variants in the CxxC domain of the epigenetic regulator KDM2B support its role in developmental eye anomalies
source.quote: Both individuals exhibited complex structural eye defects, with neurodevelopmental, cardiac and renal anomalies variably present.

numbers.metric: Screened families with developmental eye disorders
